sloka: यस्मादवध्यां मे पत्नीमवधीः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।तस्मात्त्वं मानुषे लोके जनिष्यसि जनार्दन ।। ७.५१.१५ ॥
transliteration: yasmādavadhyāṁ me patnīmavadhīḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ।tasmāttvaṁ mānuṣe loke janiṣyasi janārdana ।। 7.51.15 ॥

translations.english: There, you will experience separation from your wife for many years.
